other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Milk pasteurization described as flow-rated processing lines (15,000 L/h), a continuous liquid-processing step upstream of the discrete pot/bottle packaging
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: Pasteurization: This is the second step in the manufacturing process; it consists in making the product holy from all microorganisms, at a temperature of 92 ° C, with two lines with a total capacity of 15,000 liters per hour.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Powdering/reconstitution lines rated in liters per hour, flow-process dairy treatment
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: the company has three capacity lines of 3x5500 liters per hour.

one_line: The paper applies an electrical energy-management procedure (SEC/SECC indicators and load-curve shifting) to a yogurt manufacturing plant in the Algerian agro-food sector, which is explicitly out of Corpus B scope (discrete/batch food production with pot and bottle packaging).
